description: Be-Mobile describes historical traffic events including roadworks, congestion and accidents, combining official sources with user reports such as those from Flitsmeister. A companion record separately describes the app's road-user feedback, including road-surface issues. Both are grouped as related feed components, with potentially overlapping reports and distinct native identities preserved. Coverage is mainly the Benelux, and the provider states that locally stored data can be shared on request. Exact retention periods, observation counts, schemas, licence terms and charges are not specified. The generic title does not identify the unrelated Bolzano traffic-event dataset. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
